subtopic: Investment Advisory Agreements and Terms of Service
source_evidence: In addition, read any Terms of Service or similar agreements provided in the adviser’s mobile app or on its website. Information or terms in those agreements might be incorporated in your advisory agreement (or vice versa).
answer: Before agreeing to subscription-based advisory fees, read the investment advisory agreement to understand the services you will receive and the fees you will pay. Read the adviser’s Terms of Service as well: terms in those documents may be incorporated into the advisory agreement, or the other way around. Even if the agreement appears as an “I agree” checkbox in an app or on a website, it is a legal document, so review it before accepting.
